summary: Barclays PLC filed a routine Form 6-K batch dated 2 November 2026 comprising London Stock Exchange notices: total voting rights as of 30 September 2026 (13,372,261,916 ordinary shares, no treasury shares); admission to trading of 2,187,284 further shares for September; and four weekly transaction-in-own-shares disclosures (5, 12, 19, 26 October). The buyback, announced 29 July 2026 and executed via Citigroup Global Markets Limited, shows purchases for cancellation at volume-weighted prices of roughly 441p-465p per share. Following cancellations, issued capital stands at 13,366,146,890 shares. No board recommendation or advisor opinion is provided; watch execution pace against the announced programme and any overhang from daily purchases.
